messages:
Kelsea: Heads-up 80 I pulled a few edge cases from the AtlasCloud announce intake. Need quick alignment on who owns these hybrid leads before we flip the public page. Can we triage now?

Marco (Marketplace): Quick summary of the three leads: A) trial -> marketplace checkout last week, B) inbound from SI event (Atlas workshop) last month, C) existing customer said SI introduced Redwood.

Tariq (SI-Atlas): For B and C our team ran discovery sessions. For B we have meeting notes + slide deck; for C SI led an internal PoC but customer still on evaluation.

Kelsea: Proposed immediate rule set (draft):
- If account has active contract (any Redwood enterprise deal) -> AE retains ownership.
- If lead originated via marketplace purchase within last 30 days -> marketplace primary unless SI provides signed SOW or MOU dated before marketplace purchase.
- SI has a 14-day claim window from first SI recorded engagement to register via intake with evidence. If not claimed in 14d, marketplace wins if they have first paid activity.
- For high ACV (>250k) auto-escalate to AE/partner arbitration channel.

Priya (Legal): The signed SOW requirement is fine. Need to ensure evidence definition: signed doc or formal MOU email thread from partner domain. No screenshots alone.

Rae (Ops): We'll need CRM flags: origin_source, partner_claim_ts, evidence_url, evidence_type. Ops can add fields but need ticket with exact names.

intake-bot: Suggested intake payload example:
```
origin: marketplace|si|referral
partner_claim_ts: <unix_ts>
evidence_type: SOW|MOU|meeting_notes
evidence_url: https://...
first_paid_ts: <unix_ts or null>
acv_estimate: <number>
```
Routing pseudo: 
```
if enterprise_contract:true -> OWNER=AE
else if evidence_type in [SOW,MOU] and evidence_ts < marketplace_purchase_ts -> OWNER=SI
else if origin==marketplace and days_since_purchase <=30 -> OWNER=Marketplace
else if partner_claim_ts and days_between(partner_claim_ts, first_engagement_ts)<=14 -> OWNER=SI
else if acv_estimate>250000 -> OWNER=AE_ESCALATE
else OWNER=Marketplace
```

Marco (Marketplace): That looks good. A question: how do we handle cases where SI and marketplace both contribute to the sale? We need a crediting matrix.

Priya (Legal): We'll need to codify revenue recognition/commission splits in the partner addendum. For now recommend provisional splits in CRM notes until legal signs off.

Tariq (SI-Atlas): Operational ask: if intake-bot routes to AE_ESCALATE, it should auto-create a thread in #partners-escalate and ping Tariq and the AE DRI.

Rae (Ops): Agreed. Ops will add webhook to intake pipeline to post to #partners-escalate when OWNER=AE_ESCALATE. Need list of DRI tags.

Kelsea: Final checks: define evidence minimal set (signed SOW or MOU email OR partner-signed Statement of Work PDF), claim window 14 days, marketplace 30-day recent purchase priority, enterprise contract overrides. I'll consolidate into a one-pager and push to Confluence.

Marco (Marketplace): I'll prep two example leads and walk ops through fields tomorrow.

Tariq (SI-Atlas): We'll export the meeting notes + MOU links for leads B/C into the intake form by EOD.

Priya (Legal): I'll draft short language for partner addendum regarding crediting and evidence rules; will share by Tue.

Rae (Ops): Filing ops ticket now: CRM-4762 (add partner_claim_ts, evidence_url, evidence_type, origin_source). ETA 5 business days.

Kelsea: Action items summary: 1) Kelsea -> Confluence one-pager + link to intake schema (tomorrow) 2) Rae -> ops ticket CRM-4762 (in flight) 3) Marco -> sample lead exports (tomorrow) 4) Tariq -> upload evidence to intake (EOD) 5) Priya -> partner addendum draft (Tue). Please react when you've started your item. :eyes:

intake-bot: Calendar note: "SI-Atlas routing dry-run" scheduled for 2024-07-02 09:30 PT. Invite sent to participants.
